Heavenly Hash
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, December 21, 2009 - 11:50pm

Ingredients




2 cups cooked rice
1 envelope whipped cream mix, prepared
1 1/2 cups milk
1/4 cup sugar
1 cup drained pineapple tidbits
1 lg. orange, peeled, seeded, and diced
1/4 cup chopped maraschino cherries
1 cup miniature marshmallows
1/2 cup flaked coconut
1/4 cup nuts, chopped

Preparation

1 Combine rice, milk, and sugar. Cook until thick and creamy, about 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cool. Fold in remaining ingredients. Spoon into serving dishes and chill.
